source.title: Corpus of Texts in the Indus Script

source_ocr_locator_exposure.consequence: Strict number blinding is limited for this annotation group. Printed fields were read from source pixels; no earlier field observation was replaced after disclosure.

conventions.unit_order: visual left to right in upright original source drawing
conventions.drawn_unit_count: Modern printed drawings, including editorial auxiliaries. Dashed uncertainty underlines are attributes of a drawing, not additional units.
conventions.original_sign_count: Null throughout; physical line/side extent is unresolved.
conventions.classification_literal: Exact five positions, including literal spaces.
conventions.strict_candidate_codes: Finnish lower chart codes compatible with the source drawing and its observed uncertainty underline.
conventions.shape_only_candidate_codes: Looser visual code alternatives when uncertainty underlining is disregarded. These sets do not replace strict candidates.
conventions.crop_correct: True only when the selected glyph_pdf_box retains the full target drawing ink and excludes neighbouring row and printed margin ink. The full context crop supplies the independent reading even when that selected box fails.
conventions.confidence: Qualitative visual judgment, without probability calibration.
